title: Sentience-Status Adjudication Record
description: Machine-checkable form of the Chapter Five Sentience-Status Adjudication Record. Binding homes: Article V-E (Sentience-Status Adjudication Floor); Def.P1 Sentience-Status Adjudication Record; Chapter Eleven §5 Sentience-status adjudication hook. This file is a validating schema, not a standing record and not who-counts. This schema cannot decide who counts.

recorded_at.description: Optional ISO-8601 timestamp for when this record was written. Inspectability aid; not a standing timestamp.

case_id.description: Optional forum case identifier. This record is not the whole Forum Case Record.

subject_entity.description: Who or what was reviewed. Identity only — this schema cannot decide who counts.

status_determination_or_live_contested_p.description: Status determination or live contested posture. Not a who-counts taxonomy and not a standing effect.

lead_forum_family.description: Lead forum family. Default under Chapter Eleven §5 is Technical Forum Domains.

chapter_eleven_special_route.description: Any Chapter Eleven–warranted special route actually used. Use none when the default Technical Forum Domains lead applies with no special route.

indicators.description: Indicators relied on. This field records what was used; it does not decide who counts.

material_uncertainty_noted.description: Material uncertainty must be noted. Unresolved uncertainty alone cannot withhold Chapter Six protection.

interim_contested_sentient_life_treatmen.description: Interim Contested-Sentient Life treatment while status remains live.

narrowing.description: Any narrowing's declared expected-closure timeline and mandatory periodic-review trigger. Null timeline fields only when this record is not a narrowing.
